$comment: News shown on the home page. Order does not matter: they are sorted automatically from the most recent. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; 'end' is optional (for events lasting several days). 'text' supports [link](https://...), **bold** and *italic*.

items.text: My first pre-print, "A PDE approach to Benamou–Brenier formula for the Schrödinger problem", co-authored with Luca Nenna, Simona Rota Nodari, and Luca Tamanini, is now available.

items.alt: Visit to Simona Rota Nodari in Nice
items.text: I visited Prof. Simona Rota Nodari at Université Côte d'Azur, Nice (France).
I visited Dr. Luca Tamanini at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Brescia (Italy) and gave a talk on "Entropic regularization(s) of Optimal Transport problem(s)".
I visited Dr. Luca Tamanini at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Brescia (Italy).
I have been at CIRM (Marseille) for the workshop ["Calculus of Variations and applications"](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/3460.html).
I participated in the workshop ["Modelling Viscoelastic Fluids"](https://www.dmf.bs.unicatt.it/~musesti/merla/viscoelastic/).

I participated in the workshop in honour of Marco Degiovanni's 70th birthday ["Advances in Calculus of Variations and Nonlinear Analysis"](https://www.unicatt.it/en/events/events/brescia/2025/advances-in-calculus-of-variations-and-nonlinear-analysis.html).

items.alt: Visit to Luca Nenna in Paris
items.text: I visited Prof. Luca Nenna at Université Paris-Saclay, Paris (France).
I obtained the master's degree in Mathematics.
